# BrainKart

> BrainKart is a comprehensive online education portal providing lecture notes, study materials, and exam preparation resources for engineering, medical, pharmacy, and MBA courses.

BrainKart serves students across multiple disciplines with curated content for university curricula, competitive entrance exams, and professional certifications. The platform specializes in Anna University resources and major entrance exam preparation including GATE, NEET, AIIMS, and IIT JEE.

## Key Topics

- Anna University
- Lecture Notes
- Entrance Exams
- NEET
- GATE
- MBBS
- Engineering Courses
- Medical Education
- Question Papers
- Study Materials
- Exam Preparation
- CSE/IT
- Civil Engineering
- Mechanical Engineering
- Pharmacy

## Anna University Resources

- [Anna University Lecture Notes, Important Questions and Answers, Question Paper Regulation 2017, 2021](https://www.brainkart.com/menu/anna-university): Anna University lecture notes, questions, and study materials for all departments and semesters
- [Anna University CSE and AID Lecture Notes, Important Questions and Answers, Question Paper Regulation 2017, 2021](https://www.brainkart.com/menu/anna-university-cse): Anna University CSE and AID department lecture notes and study materials for all semesters
- [Anna University IT Lecture Notes, Important Questions and Answers, Question Paper Regulation 2017, 2021](https://www.brainkart.com/menu/anna-university-it): Anna University IT department lecture notes and study materials for all semesters
- [Anna University EEE Lecture Notes, Important Questions and Answers, Question Paper Regulation 2017, 2021](https://www.brainkart.com/menu/anna-university-eee): Anna University EEE department lecture notes and study materials for all semesters
- [Anna University ECE Lecture Notes, Important Questions and Answers, Question Paper Regulation 2017, 2021](https://www.brainkart.com/menu/anna-university-ece): Anna University ECE department lecture notes and study materials for all semesters
- [Anna University Mechanical Lecture Notes, Important Questions and Answers, Question Paper Regulation 2017, 2021](https://www.brainkart.com/menu/anna-university-mech): Anna University Mechanical Engineering lecture notes and study materials for all semesters
- [Anna University Civil Lecture Notes, Important Questions and Answers, Question Paper Regulation 2017, 2021](https://www.brainkart.com/menu/anna-university-civil): Anna University Civil Engineering lecture notes and study materials for all semesters

## Competitive Entrance Exam Preparation

- [NEET Entrance Exam | Under Graduate Entrance Exams Online Objective Test](https://test.brainkart.com/objective/under-graduate-entrance-exams/neet-entrance-exam): NEET online objective tests and practice questions for medical entrance exam preparation
- [AIIMS Entrance Exams | Under Graduate Entrance Exams Online Objective Test](https://test.brainkart.com/objective/under-graduate-entrance-exams/aiims-entrance-exams): AIIMS online objective tests and practice questions for MBBS entrance exam preparation
- [GATE Exam Online Objective Test - GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering) Entrance exams](https://test.brainkart.com/objective/gate-exam): GATE exam online objective tests and practice questions for engineering entrance preparation
- [IIT JEE IEEE Entrance Exam | Under Graduate Entrance Exams Online Objective Test](https://test.brainkart.com/objective/under-graduate-entrance-exams/iit-jee-ieee-entrance-exam): IIT JEE online objective tests and practice questions for undergraduate entrance exam preparation
- [TANCET Anna University Online Objective Test](https://test.brainkart.com/objective/tancet-anna-university): TANCET online objective tests for M.E. and M.Tech entrance exam preparation
